quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching a yield sign if required for safety to stop shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway.

activation.description: Driver approaches an intersection governed by a yield sign, and safety requires stopping
activation.source_clause: The driver of a vehicle approaching a yield sign if required for safety to stop

obligation.description: Stop before nearest-side crosswalk, else marked stop line, else nearest point with view of intersecting-highway traffic
obligation.source_clause: shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic

timing.description: Conditional need assessed on approach; stopping reference precedes intersection entry

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: if required for safety to stop
judgment_calls_needed.note: Whether traffic and sight conditions required a stop is an independent legal judgment, not a time-to-conflict cutoff.
